newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips gain at the the open, Nasdaq eases.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips gain at the the open, Nasdaq eases.

text.p: The Dow industrials opened higher on Friday, while Nasdaq softened slightly following the release of the Producer Price index for June, which pointed to stable inflation.
The Dow Industrials was up 6.33 at 7,893.09 at the start. The Nasdaq Composite was off 1.23 at 1,489.70, while the S&P Index was off 0.02 at 913.76.
The 30-year long bond up 1/32 at 6.56 percent yield.
